#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""S2 editor_export real-take acceptance check (lane-local driver; outputs are gitignored).

Predeclared in docs/spec/sprints/EDITOR_EXPORT_S2.md: one bounded FFprobe decoded-frame
scan (300 s timeout) plus one streamed source SHA-256, a hash-verified metadata
mirror, and exporter arms that must write zero files and report
calibration_required / cadence variable (unknown without PTS). Read-only inputs
are hashed before and after. Nothing is tuned on the take.
"""
from collections import Counter
from fractions import Fraction
import glob
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

WT = Path("/Users/jess/git/video-utils/.local/sprint2/editor_export")
sys.path.insert(0, str(WT / "scripts"))
import editor_marker_plan as planner  # noqa: E402
import editor_marker_export as exporter  # noqa: E402

RUN = Path("/Users/jess/git/video-utils/artifacts/runs/20261006T034521Z-a0def0c43eac")
FULLER = Path("/Users/jess/git/video-utils/artifacts/runs/20261006T041633Z-990aa1bd6737")
OUT = WT / "artifacts/s2/editor_export/real-take"
RECEIPT = WT / "docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261006-s2/editor_export-real-take-receipt.json"
SOURCE = "a522115f4e72e19384fb341bc84369728eceefe49183b8c6367a1008a95176c6"
SELECTION = "reference-marked-preview-compact/selection.json"
EXPECTED = {"frame_count": 3621, "steps": {"24": 43, "25": 3528, "26": 49}, "extent_seconds": "90531/600",
            "first_tick": 0, "last_tick": 90506}
FFPROBE = os.environ["FFPROBE"]


def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def run(command, timeout):
    started = time.monotonic()
    done = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    return done, round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    return sha(path)


def main():
    takes = glob.glob("/Users/jess/Documents/Movie on 10-5-26 at 3.38*PM.mov")
    assert len(takes) == 1, takes
    take = Path(takes[0])
    assert not OUT.exists(), f"{OUT} exists; refusing to mix runs"
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True)
    graph = json.loads((RUN / "dag.json").read_text())
    mirror_names = ["markers.json", "manifest.json", "flags.json", "dag.json", SELECTION,
                    *sorted(graph["artifact_hashes"])]
    readonly = {str(take): take, **{str(RUN / n): RUN / n for n in mirror_names},
                str(RUN / "arrangement-reference-20261006/arrangement-markers.json"):
                    RUN / "arrangement-reference-20261006/arrangement-markers.json",
                str(FULLER / "manifest.json"): FULLER / "manifest.json",
                str(WT / "program/instrument.json"): WT / "program/instrument.json"}
    before = {name: sha(path) for name, path in readonly.items()}
    receipt = {"schema_version": 1, "format": "s2_editor_export_real_take_receipt", "lane": "editor_export",
               "sprint": "20261006-s2", "linear": "TIN-5606", "authority": "R-HOOK-CONVERGENCE-20261004 R-N11/R-N12/R-N13",
               "contract": "docs/spec/sprints/EDITOR_EXPORT_S2.md@2579462", "take_path": str(take),
               "source_sha256_expected": SOURCE, "source_sha256_measured": before[str(take)],
               "source_identity": "match" if before[str(take)] == SOURCE else "MISMATCH",
               "fuller_run": {"path": str(FULLER), "manifest_sha256": before[str(FULLER / "manifest.json")],
                              "source_sha256": json.loads((FULLER / "manifest.json").read_text())["source"]["sha256"],
                              "use": "source identity only; carries no markers.json"},
               "driver_sha256": sha(Path(__file__))}
    version, _ = run([FFPROBE, "-version"], 30)
    stream, stream_seconds = run([FFPROBE, "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries",
                                  "stream=time_base,avg_frame_rate,r_frame_rate,nb_frames,start_pts,start_time,duration",
                                  "-of", "json", str(take)], 60)
    assert stream.returncode == 0, stream.stderr[-2000:]
    video = json.loads(stream.stdout)["streams"][0]
    scan, scan_seconds = run([FFPROBE, "-v", "error", "-threads", "2", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_frames",
                              "-show_entries", "frame=best_effort_timestamp,duration", "-of", "json=compact=1",
                              str(take)], 300)
    assert scan.returncode == 0, scan.stderr[-2000:]
    raw = json.loads(scan.stdout)["frames"]
    missing = sum(1 for row in raw if "duration" not in row or "best_effort_timestamp" not in row)
    frames = [{"best_effort_timestamp": int(row["best_effort_timestamp"]), "duration": int(row["duration"])}
              for row in raw if "duration" in row and "best_effort_timestamp" in row]
    pts = {"schema_version": 1, "source_sha256": SOURCE, "clock": "original_source_stream_timestamps_seconds",
           "time_base": video["time_base"], "frames": frames,
           "producer": {"tool": "ffprobe", "version_line": version.stdout.decode().splitlines()[0],
                        "entries": "frame=best_effort_timestamp,duration", "stream": "v:0",
                        "frames_missing_fields": missing, "class": "measured_decoded_frame_view_not_editor_interpretation"}}
    pts_sha = dump(OUT / "pts.json", pts)
    tick = Fraction(video["time_base"])
    starts = [f["best_effort_timestamp"] for f in frames]
    steps = Counter(b - a for a, b in zip(starts, starts[1:]))
    durations = Counter(f["duration"] for f in frames)
    measured = {"frame_count": len(frames), "steps": {str(k): steps[k] for k in sorted(steps)},
                "durations": {str(k): durations[k] for k in sorted(durations)},
                "extent_seconds": planner.ratio((starts[-1] + frames[-1]["duration"] - starts[0]) * tick),
                "first_tick": starts[0], "last_tick": starts[-1]}
    comparison = {key: {"expected": EXPECTED[key], "measured": measured[key], "match": EXPECTED[key] == measured[key]}
                  for key in EXPECTED}
    receipt["pts_scan"] = {"command": "$FFPROBE -v error -threads 2 -select_streams v:0 -show_frames -show_entries "
                           "frame=best_effort_timestamp,duration -of json=compact=1 <take>",
                           "timeout_seconds": 300, "elapsed_seconds": scan_seconds,
                           "stream_probe_elapsed_seconds": stream_seconds, "stream_metadata": video,
                           "ffprobe_version": pts["producer"]["version_line"], "pts_json_sha256": pts_sha,
                           "pts_json": str((OUT / "pts.json").relative_to(WT)), "measured": measured,
                           "comparison_with_research": comparison,
                           "all_match": all(row["match"] for row in comparison.values()),
                           "frames_missing_fields": missing}
    # Hash-verified metadata mirror.
    mirror = OUT / "run"
    for name in mirror_names:
        target = mirror / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(RUN / name, target)
        assert sha(target) == before[str(RUN / name)], name
    shutil.copyfile(OUT / "pts.json", mirror / "pts.json")
    generic, _, _ = planner.read_json(mirror / "markers.json")
    all_generic = {"source_sha256": SOURCE, "selected_markers": [
        {"marker_index": i, "marker_id": planner.marker_id(i, m)} for i, m in enumerate(generic["markers"])],
        "provenance": "lane-derived explicit all-generic selection (deviation arm); not an operator selection"}
    dump(mirror / "selection-all-generic.json", all_generic)
    url = exporter.file_url_from_path(str(take))
    base = {"source_sha256": SOURCE, "source_origin": 0, "asset_origin": 0, "clip_in": 0,
            "clip_out": planner.SourceDecimal("150.954059"), "parent_offset": 0,
            "fixture_grid": {"frame_duration": "1/24", "origin": 0, "frame_id_origin": 0}}
    arms = {}

    def profiles(tag, target, selection, with_pts):
        profile = dict(base, target=target)
        names = ["markers.json", "manifest.json", selection] + (["pts.json"] if with_pts else [])
        if with_pts:
            profile["pts_artifact"] = "pts.json"
        profile["input_sha256"] = {n: sha(mirror / n) for n in names}
        plan_name = f"editor-profile-{tag}.json"
        (mirror / plan_name).write_text(json.dumps(profile, allow_nan=False))
        fmt = "fcpxml" if target == "final_cut_pro" else "resolve_ops"
        export = {"schema_version": 1, "format": "editor_marker_export_profile", "plan_profile": plan_name,
                  "plan_profile_sha256": sha(mirror / plan_name),
                  "timecode": {"drop_frame": False, "origin_label": "00:00:00:00"}}
        if fmt == "fcpxml":
            export["fcpxml"] = {"event_name": "video-utils review", "asset_name": "Movie on 10-5-26",
                                "media_src_url": url, "width": None, "height": None}
        export_name = f"export-profile-{tag}.json"
        dump(mirror / export_name, export)
        return fmt, plan_name, export_name

    def cli(tag, target, selection, with_pts):
        fmt, plan_name, export_name = profiles(tag, target, selection, with_pts)
        out = OUT / "exports" / tag
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        before_listing = sorted(str(p.relative_to(OUT)) for p in OUT.rglob("*"))
        done, seconds = run([sys.executable, str(WT / "scripts/editor_marker_export.py"), str(mirror), selection,
                             export_name, "--format", fmt, "--output-dir", str(out), "--summary"], 120)
        after_listing = sorted(str(p.relative_to(OUT)) for p in OUT.rglob("*"))
        value = json.loads(done.stdout) if done.returncode == 0 else None
        arms[tag] = {"entrypoint": "build", "format": fmt, "selection": selection, "with_pts": with_pts,
                     "exit_status": done.returncode, "elapsed_seconds": seconds,
                     "stderr": done.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")[-1000:],
                     "output_dir_exists_after": out.exists(), "new_paths": sorted(set(after_listing) - set(before_listing)),
                     "result": None if value is None else {k: value.get(k) for k in (
                         "native_export_status", "cadence", "reasons", "plan_status", "application_import",
                         "host_frame_id", "executable", "api_contract", "native_contract_status", "dtd_validation",
                         "files_written", "metadata_cadence_hint", "counts", "input_sha256", "worker_sha256",
                         "listening_acceptance", "musical_verdict")}}
        if value is not None:
            arms[tag]["cadence_evidence"] = value["cadence_evidence"]
        return arms[tag]

    # Predeclared selection through the hash-verified build entrypoint.
    cli("predeclared-build-fcpxml", "final_cut_pro", SELECTION, True)
    # Fallback (contract step 2): pure make_plan on read-only loaded JSON.
    arrangement, arrangement_sha, _ = planner.read_json(RUN / "arrangement-reference-20261006/arrangement-markers.json")
    selection, selection_sha, _ = planner.read_json(RUN / SELECTION)
    manifest = json.loads((RUN / "manifest.json").read_text())
    probe_video = manifest["source"]["probe"]["video"]
    rates = {"average_rational": probe_video.get("avg_frame_rate"), "nominal_rational": probe_video.get("r_frame_rate")}
    pts_loaded, _, _ = planner.read_json(OUT / "pts.json")
    for tag, target, with_pts in (("pure-fcpxml", "final_cut_pro", True), ("pure-resolve_ops", "davinci_resolve", True),
                                  ("pure-fcpxml-no-pts", "final_cut_pro", False)):
        fmt, plan_name, export_name = profiles(tag, target, SELECTION, with_pts)
        plan_profile, plan_sha, _ = planner.read_json(mirror / plan_name)
        export_profile, export_sha, _ = planner.read_json(mirror / export_name)
        pts_arg = pts_loaded if with_pts else None
        plan = planner.make_plan(arrangement, selection, plan_profile, pts_arg)
        hashes = {"arrangement-reference-20261006/arrangement-markers.json": arrangement_sha, SELECTION: selection_sha,
                  plan_name: plan_sha, export_name: export_sha, **({"pts.json": pts_sha} if with_pts else {})}
        result, files = exporter.export_plan(plan, arrangement, plan_profile, export_profile, pts_arg, fmt, hashes,
                                             "pure_make_plan", rates)
        out = OUT / "exports" / tag
        if files:
            exporter.write_exclusive(out, result, files)
        arms[tag] = {"entrypoint": "pure_make_plan", "format": fmt, "selection": SELECTION, "with_pts": with_pts,
                     "generic_markers": "arrangement-reference-20261006/arrangement-markers.json",
                     "output_dir_exists_after": out.exists(), "payload_files": sorted(files),
                     "result": {k: result.get(k) for k in (
                         "native_export_status", "cadence", "reasons", "plan_status", "application_import",
                         "host_frame_id", "executable", "api_contract", "native_contract_status", "dtd_validation",
                         "files_written", "metadata_cadence_hint", "counts", "input_sha256", "worker_sha256",
                         "listening_acceptance", "musical_verdict")},
                     "row_host_frame_id_all_null": all(r["host_frame_id"] is None for r in result["markers"]),
                     "row_count": len(result["markers"])}
        if with_pts:
            arms[tag]["cadence_evidence"] = result["cadence_evidence"]
        dump(OUT / f"stdout-{tag}.json", result)
    # Deviation arms: build entrypoint with a lane-derived explicit all-generic selection.
    for tag, target, with_pts in (("deviation-build-fcpxml", "final_cut_pro", True),
                                  ("deviation-build-resolve_ops", "davinci_resolve", True),
                                  ("deviation-build-fcpxml-no-pts", "final_cut_pro", False)):
        cli(tag, target, "selection-all-generic.json", with_pts)
    after = {name: sha(path) for name, path in readonly.items()}
    receipt["arms"] = arms
    receipt["readonly_inputs"] = {"count": len(before), "unchanged": before == after,
                                  "sha256_before": before, "changed": sorted(k for k in before if before[k] != after[k])}
    receipt["exports_directory_contents"] = sorted(str(p.relative_to(OUT)) for p in (OUT / "exports").rglob("*")) \
        if (OUT / "exports").exists() else []
    dump(OUT / "driver-result.json", receipt)
    print(json.dumps({"source_identity": receipt["source_identity"], "all_match": receipt["pts_scan"]["all_match"],
                      "arms": {k: (v.get("exit_status"), v["result"] and v["result"]["native_export_status"],
                                   v["result"] and v["result"]["cadence"], v["result"] and v["result"]["reasons"],
                                   v["output_dir_exists_after"]) for k, v in arms.items()},
                      "readonly_unchanged": receipt["readonly_inputs"]["unchanged"]}, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
